claims.promise: The first week is not a blank app: the user photographs or picks the paper log or screenshot they already have, and those rows become the starting history.

evidence.finding: A 2026-09-17 Shotsy review says the app asked to add a first shot after weeks of logging and the previous entry was gone, so users already keep a history the phone must be able to take in.

claims.deferredReason: No paper-log capture or row importer exists; resolve when a fixture photo or picked image produces the expected starting shot rows.

claims.promise: One tap logs the prescribed dose on a body-site map that remembers the last eight weeks, with side effects tagged in hours-since-shot rather than as a detached diary.

evidence.finding: 14 of 15 visible titles on the 2026-10-10 GLP-1 tracker search page name a shot or GLP-1 tracking job, so the weekly dose-and-site act is the shelf, not a side feature.

claims.deferredReason: No dose row, site map or hours-since-shot tagger exists; resolve when a unit test writes one dose on a named site with a side-effect offset.

claims.promise: A plate is a photograph plus a caption and optional typed protein grams; no model guesses the meal.

comparison.limitation: A 2026-08-21 featured review says meal photos consistently get it wrong and the AI edit cursor jumps.

evidence.finding: Jenna's 2026-08-21 MeAgain review reports wrong AI meal photos; Pep's listing sells an AI food scanner on the same shelf.

claims.deferredReason: No plate capture path exists; resolve when TakePicture or PickVisualMedia stores a still with a caption and no nutrition API call.

claims.promise: Killing the process or never signing in cannot wipe the shot history; there is no login that can ask for a first shot after month three.

comparison.limitation: A 2026-09-17 featured review says shot entries vanish after login and the app asks to add a first shot.

evidence.finding: Nikolai Efimov's 2026-09-17 Shotsy review describes lost weekly shot entries after login; AppInsider's October 2026 roll-up of 118 US reviews names login and account problems as a top complaint cluster.

claims.deferredReason: No local store or process-death test exists; resolve when a kill-and-recreate test restores the same shot rows without an account.

claims.promise: A dated PDF and CSV of doses, sites, side effects, weights and plate thumbnails leave through the system share sheet or a SAF create-document write.

comparison.limitation: The listing offers notes to discuss with a provider but the featured 2026-08-30 review says the useful screen is a subscription paywall.

evidence.finding: MeAgain's own listing tells the user to keep notes for a healthcare provider, and Lauren Freeman's 2026-08-30 review says that place to track is locked behind a monthly or yearly fee.

claims.deferredReason: No PDF or share path exists; resolve when instrumentation sees ACTION_SEND or ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT with a FileProvider or SAF URI.

claims.promise: A home-screen tile shows next shot day and the last site so the routine is visible without opening another subscription tracker.

evidence.finding: Jenna's 2026-08-21 MeAgain review calls that app's widget cute but useless, so a tile that only shows next shot day and last site is the part of the widget job the shelf has not kept.

claims.deferredReason: No Glance widget exists; resolve when a GlanceAppWidget reads next shot day and last site from the local store.
